description:
Ready to go from graduate to trusted advisor for Europe’s best-known brands in just 12 months? Expect a steep learning curve, real responsibility, and hands-on experience working with AI every day.

💚 About us

Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Most companies still judge their marketing by last-click. Our AI-powered attribution shows which channels actually drive revenue, and our platform automatically moves ad budgets to where they have the most impact. As a Zurich-based AI scale-up of around 30 people, we support leading European brands in e-commerce, telecommunications, banking, insurance and energy.

🚀 Your mission

Get future-proof. In our 12-month traineeship you learn, at the intersection of marketing, analytics and AI, how modern marketing is measured and optimized with algorithms. You will have a dedicated expert buddy to show you the ropes. You won't learn how AI replaces your job, but how to work with it and achieve more. After one year, you look after your own clients and move into a permanent role in our Customer Success & Account Management team.

🗺️ Your year at Nexoya

  • Foundations (Months 1 to 3): You learn how digital advertising works, from search to social to display, using Google, Meta, TikTok and Snapchat as examples. Then you dive into analytics and attribution, understand how our algorithms optimize budgets, and get your personal AI toolkit.

  • Applied (Months 4 to 8): Together with your buddy you look after your first clients and lead your first calls yourself. You also spend time in marketing, sales and product, and join a sprint with our Founder & CEO.

  • Ownership (Months 9 to 12): You look after clients fully on your own and take responsibility for your own projects.

🧑‍💻 Your tasks

  • Analyze cross-channel performance data (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Snap, etc.)

  • Master attribution, marketing mix modeling and incrementality, and explain them clearly to our clients

  • Prepare, interpret and present the budget optimizations from our platform

  • Work with AI tools every day for analysis, reporting and client meeting preparation

  • Understand what a client really needs, challenge assumptions with data and turn insights into clear recommendations, in German and English

  • Own projects that move our team and our platform forward

🎯 What you bring

  • You are at the start of your career, eager, like taking responsibility and want to learn fast

  • Enthusiasm for AI and analytics: you don't need to be a developer, but you should want to work with AI every day

  • A completed or soon-to-be-completed degree in business, data science, marketing or a related field

  • Enjoy working with numbers and data, for example in Excel or Google Sheets

  • Fluent in German and English is a must, Italian is a plus

  • A plus: your own AI projects, an internship in performance marketing, first experience with Claude, SQL, Python or BI tools

Why Nexoya?

✨ Future-proof skills: AI, marketing and analytics in one program

✨ A clear plan with fixed milestones, a personal buddy and regular development talks. You also start together with a second trainee

✨ A permanent contract from day one, plus a fixed salary increase and equity in Nexoya (ESOP) once you complete the traineeship

✨ A personal learning budget, for example for Google Ads or Meta certifications

✨ A real AI-first culture. Experiment, automate and share what you build, and work with MCPs, coworkers and agents

✨ A team you’ll love working with, an office just a few minutes’ walk from Zurich main station and the flexibility to work from home 3 days/week

✨ Twice a year the whole team travels somewhere special for our Strategy Days (so far Lenzerheide, Engelberg, Helsinki, Berlin and Belgrade)

title: Customer Care Associate – (Multilingual)
description:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

As Customer Care Associate, you will own customer issue resolution end to end and ensure distributors receive fast, reliable support in their day to day operations. You are accountable for ensuring customer order flow stays running and resolving customer issues as they arise.

What you’ll do

  • Own customer issues from first contact through resolution across French and Spanish-speaking markets

  • Build and deliver fast, reliable support workflows used by distributors in day-to-day operations

  • Work through messy, time-sensitive issues (order errors, blocked accounts, product problems) to keep operations running smoothly

  • Make decisions that directly impact customer satisfaction, retention, and order flow continuity

  • Improve support quality by identifying patterns in recurring issues and driving root-cause fixes

  • Take responsibility for clear escalation and coordination with internal teams when needed

  • Coaching and training of external agents supporting Choco customers

  • Collaborate with external support agents and internal teams to maintain high-quality service standards

What you bring

  • 1+ years of experience in customer support or operations in fast-paced, tech-enabled environments, with a track record of owning outcomes

  • Comfort operating across multiple tools and stakeholders in ambiguity and high-pressure situations

  • Strong judgment in prioritization and real-time problem solving

  • Accountability when things go wrong and the drive to resolve issues fully

  • Native level of French speaking & writing is required

  • Fluency in Spanish and English (C1+ written and spoken)

Working hours

This is a customer-facing operational role with fixed coverage requirements. You will work Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 18:00, including a daily upaid lunch break. You must be consistently available during these hours to support customers across both Choco and Goot.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
description:
About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni)

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do

  • Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.
  • Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.
  • Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.
  • Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

Core qualifications

  • Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.
  • Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.
  • An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.
  • Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team.

Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization.

This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive.

What we offer

Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. You'll own a focused project, receive close mentorship from experienced engineers, and have room to explore ideas that shape our optimization methods.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other's differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.

title: AI Deployment Strategist, Critical and Sovereign Institutions - Paris
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the team

The Applied AI for Critical and Sovereign Institutions team is Mistral's specialized unit dedicated to delivering high-impact, secure AI solutions for institutions operating in highly regulated and strategic environments. We work hand-in-hand with clients to design, deploy, and maintain AI systems that meet the highest standards of reliability, security, and operational excellence, including on-premise, disconnected, and air-gapped deployments.

As an AI Deployment Strategist on this team, you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral's AI solutions inside sovereign institutions and critical infrastructure, working closely with customers from strategic vision to production implementation. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI innovation, and hands-on deployment, under real operational, security, and compliance constraints. You will partner with senior leaders and mission owners to design AI roadmaps, collaborate with the Applied AI team to deliver solutions in production, and ensure seamless transitions from presales to postsales. Your work will directly contribute to projects with significant societal, operational, and strategic impact.

What you will do

Strategic Discovery & Vision Setting

  • Lead executive-level and mission-owner workshops to identify challenges and opportunities where Mistral's AI can drive step-change improvements in strategic environments.

  • Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the "art of the possible" and a clear path to value within their regulatory and security perimeter.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases, quantify impact, and align solutions with mission and organizational objectives.

AI Solution Design & Deployment

  • Architect end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral's models and platform into customer workflows and secure technical infrastructure (cloud, on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped).

  • Partner with the Applied AI team to design, prototype, and deploy AI solutions in production, ensuring scalability, security, and impact.

  • Own the execution of pilots and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology and paving the way for full-scale deployment.

Value Realization & Customer Success

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding their AI strategy and ensuring they maximize the value of their investment in Mistral.

  • Monitor key performance indicators tied to operational and business outcomes, and communicate progress to executive sponsors.

  • Proactively identify expansion opportunities across use cases and units, building on initial successes to drive long-term partnerships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral's internal teams, synthesizing feedback to influence product, science, and security roadmaps.

  • Develop reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks to scale go-to-market efforts and ensure consistent delivery excellence in regulated settings.

  • Travel (~30-60%) to foster deep client relationships and support on-site deployment.

How we work in Solutions

  • We care about people and outputs. What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it.

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before.

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years in a client-facing strategic and technical role (e.g. data science consulting, value engineering, or technical sales).

  • A degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g. Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering).

  • Foundational knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science, with the credibility to advise both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python, JavaScript, or similar) to demonstrate value.

  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous challenges into actionable solutions.

  • Executive presence and communication skills to influence senior stakeholders (VP, C-level, mission owners).

  • Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment.

  • Comfort operating under security, compliance, and confidentiality constraints.

  • Experience with sales qualification frameworks (e.g. MEDDPICC) and value-based selling is a plus.

  • Experience deploying AI in regulated or sovereign environments (defense, public sector, critical infrastructure) is a plus.

1. Het bieden van technische ondersteuning via de helpdesk, telefonisch, e-mail en via remote sessies en incidenteel onsite bij partners en/of eindklanten.

2. Het installeren en configureren van softwareoplossingen zoals PaperCut MF en Hive, Umango en DocSlide.

3. Het analyseren en oplossen van technische vraagstukken.

4. Het testen en reproduceren van klantproblemen in een virtuele omgeving.

Pre-Sales & Training

  1. Het geven van technische trainingen, workshops en online technische demonstraties.
  2. Het ondersteunen van collega's en bijdragen aan interne IT-projecten.
  3. Het beantwoorden van technische vragen van klanten en partners.
  4. Het samenwerken met support- en consultancycollega's binnen Europa.
  5. Het bezoeken van eindklanten in de BeNe-regio om installaties en trainingen ter plaatse uit te voeren.
  6. Nauwe samenwerking met het Internationale iTS Supportteam.
  7. Technische en functionele interne Presales-vragen beantwoorden.
  8. Het creëren en uitvoeren van praktische technische trainingen en workshops voor partners.


Internal IT

1. Assisteren bij technische support aan collega's op zowel de software als de hardware die het bedrijf gebruikt.

2. Ondersteuning van de interne infrastructuur en diensten.

Vereiste kwalificaties

Ervaring & Achtergrond

  1. Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van het Nederlands en een goede beheersing van het Engels.
  2. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om gemakkelijk een goede relatie op te bouwen met klanten.
  3. Ervaring met print management oplossingen, zoals "Papercut" of scanoplossingen, is meegenomen.


4. Ervaring met Microsoft Windows Server- en clientplatformen, Active Directory, Entra ID en Microsoft SQL Server.

5. Ervaring met Windows-printservers, printwachtrijen en het uitrollen van printerdrivers is een pré.

6. Gedegen kennis van netwerken (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewallpoorten en SNMP) voor het oplossen van communicatieproblemen tussen servers, clients en printers.

7. Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde aanpak van complexe technische vraagstukken.

8. Een proactieve instelling en het vermogen om nieuwe technologieën snel en zelfstandig eigen te maken.

9. In staat om zowel zelfstandig als effectief binnen een team te werken.

  1. Kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken.


Pré

  1. Eerdere ervaring in een functie op het gebied van klantenservice of technische ondersteuning.
  2. Kennis van PaperCut-functionaliteiten zoals Find-Me Printing, Print Deploy, Mobility Print en scanworkflows (scan-to-email, scan-to-folder en scan-to-cloud).
  3. Ervaring met het configureren van embedded software en kaartlezers op multifunctionele printers van merken zoals Canon, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Kyocera of HP.
  4. Ervaring met andere print- en scanmanagementoplossingen, zoals Equitrac, uniFLOW of YSoft SAFEQ.
  5. Een PaperCut-certificering, bijvoorbeeld PaperCut Certified Engineer.
  6. Ervaring met virtualisatieplatformen en Microsoft Azure.
  7. Bekendheid met macOS en Linux.

Bedrijfsbeschrijving

ITS Benelux maakt deel uit van de internationale ITS Group, een organisatie die al meer dan 35 jaar actief is en klanten ondersteunt in Europa, Noord-Amerika en daarbuiten.

Maar wat je vooral merkt als collega, is dat we ondanks onze internationale omvang een nuchtere en persoonlijke organisatie zijn gebleven.

We werken hard, helpen elkaar, vieren successen samen en geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen zich prettig voelen op hun werk.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een belangrijk onderdeel van het team.

Voel je vrij om its-group.com en printandcopycontrol.com te bezoeken om meer te weten te komen over ons bedrijf en productportfolio.

iTS is gecertificeerd volgens de ISO 9001:2015- en ISO/IEC 27001:2022-normen.

Bedrijfswaarden

Klantgericht: We streven ernaar om te zorgen dat aan de behoeften van onze klanten worden voldaan en overtroffen, en bouwen sterke, langdurige relaties op.

Flexibel & Loyaal: We investeren tijd, energie en middelen in het koesteren van onze relaties, met als doel langdurig succes.

Internationaal team met een gezinsgeest: Onze bedrijfscultuur hecht waarde aan samenwerking, waardering en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en biedt een waardevolle omgeving waar iedereen kan floreren.

ITS is niet:

Arrogant

Arrogantie laat mensen geloven dat ze altijd het beste weten. Het stopt het constante leren dat succes vereist. Wij zien arrogantie als het begin van het einde van elke organisatie.

Om te solliciteren

Denk je dat dit bij je past?

Mooi. Dan hoeven we niet per se een perfect CV te zien.

Ben jij technisch nieuwsgierig, klantgericht en heb je zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Graag ontvangen wij jouw cv, inclusief een motivatiebrief waarin je beschrijft:

1. Je praktische technische ervaring met PaperCut of andere producten binnen het ITS-portfolio, inclusief de omgevingen waarin je deze hebt geïmplementeerd, ondersteund of beheerd.

2. Voorbeelden van technische, presales- en adviesactiviteiten waaraan je hebt bijgedragen of die je hebt geleid, zoals solution design, productdemonstraties en aanbestedingstrajecten.

3. Je taalvaardigheden en, indien van toepassing, je kennis van de clusterregio en het bijbehorende partnernetwerk.

iTS is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt en zich inzet voor het opbouwen van een divers en inclusief team.
